                    at 07:50 am EDT S&P Capital IQ Add MarketScreener to your sources Share PAKISTAN ENGINEERING COMPANY LIMITED -0.98% Pakistan Engineering Company Limited reported earnings results for the full year ended June 30, 2026. For the full year, the company reported net loss was PKR 32.13 million compared to PKR 63.81 million a year ago. Basic loss per share from continuing operations was PKR 5.65 compared to PKR 11.21 a year ago. © S&P Capital IQ -

Period Day Week PECO: Dynamic Chart Company Profile Pakistan Engineering Company Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of engineering products. The Companyâ€™s products include electricity transmission and communication towers, electric motors, pumps and steel rolled products. The Company's products include steel structure, such as electricity transmission and distribution line towers (11, 132, 220 and 500 kilovolts), and telecommunication towers; pumps and turbines, such as mono block and no clogging pumps, multi stage centrifugal pumps, sludge pumps, deep well and agro turbines, and electric motors, such as horizontal foot mounted motors in drip proof and Totally Enclosed, Fan Cooled (TEFC) enclosures, flange mounted squirrel cage induction motors and vertical hollow shaft motors in drip proof and TEFC enclosures. It also offers room doors and steel lockers, such as steel safes; room doors and steel lockers for banks; foundry products, such as grey and spheroidal graphite (SG) iron castings, and bronze castings.
